{{recipesummary|category=Pea recipes|servings=6–8|time=½ hour|difficulty=1
}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:North American cuisines|North America]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] 

==Ingredients==
* 1 package (16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) frozen [[Cookbook:Pea|green peas]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1 can (4 ounces) sliced [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]], juice reserved
* 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1 can (8 ounces) [[Cookbook:Water Chestnut|water chestnuts]]
* [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|Cooking spray]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|bread crumbs]] (optional)

==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]].
# Cook peas according to package instructions, then drain.
# In a separate pan, melt butter.
# Add mushroom juice and flour to melted butter. Stir until thickened.
# Add mixture to peas, then add water chestnuts and mushrooms.
# Place in medium [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]] coated with cooking spray.
# Sprinkle breadcrumbs on top if desired.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 12–15 minutes, or until heated through.
